arguments.summary: Fixed the LRU cache bug in lru/cache.py where `get()` did not update recency on a hit. The method now re-inserts the key (del + reassign) so it moves to the most-recently-used position in the underlying dict, making subsequent evictions drop the truly least-recently-used key. Verified with the issue...
